subject: Fix kvstore overhead_hashtable_lut (#1676)
reason: The fix only changes kvstoreCreate for kvstores created without KVSTORE_ALLOCATE_HASHTABLES_ON_DEMAND (the eager hashtable-creation loop previously ran before overhead_hashtable_lut was zeroed, discarding its accounting). Every kvstore the server creates (per-db keys/expires in server.c, pubsub channels, emptyDbAsync in lazyfree.c, SWAPDB temp DBs in db.c) always passes KVSTORE_ALLOCATE_HASHTABLES_ON_DEMAND, so the eager loop never runs and the reorder is a no-op for valkey-server: no command reply, MEMORY STATS value, or crash behavior differs between the builds.
